brief: A working shipyard founded in 1975 on the harbour edge of a small town: tugs, trawlers and offshore vessels up on blocks and cradles on a concrete hardstand, a tall red lattice crawler crane, a grey low-roofed steel fabrication shed and white shrink-wrapped work tents, stacked steel plate and blocks, a floating drydock at the quay, a chain-link fence with stop signs and 'no foot traffic' notices along the street, pickups parked outside. Four photos. Foundations and quay piles taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Shipyard
